idea.title: Busy isn't why you're losing deals
idea.angle: Manual processes can't keep up with growth; it's a system problem, not effort
idea.hook: Busy isn't why you're losing deals

slides.heading: **Busy** isn't why you're losing deals
slides.body: A note to myself after another week of talking to agents.

slides.heading: **Every agent** I meet is working hard
slides.body: Viewings in the morning, landlord calls at lunch, WhatsApp replies at night. Effort isn't the problem. I haven't met a lazy agent yet.

slides.heading: The leak starts when you **grow**
slides.body: Say you get ten enquiries a week. You reply to all of them. Triple that, and messages start slipping. Same agent, same effort.

slides.heading: I saw the message. I meant to reply. Then the day happened.
Effort can't fix a **system problem**
slides.body: More late nights just move the leak to a different hour. You need a process that keeps running when you can't.

slides.heading: Write down **where leads go**
slides.body: For one week, note every enquiry: where it came from, when you replied, what happened next. The gaps show up fast.

slides.heading: Start with the **first reply**
slides.body: Save a WhatsApp quick reply: "Thanks for asking about the Kumasi plot. I'm on a viewing, full details by 4pm. Buying or renting?"

slides.heading: **Fix the system**, not your sleep
slides.body: Follow @kortexa and DM 'SYSTEM' for a free trial

caption:
Busy isn't why you're losing deals.

Every agent I talk to is working hard.
The problem shows up when enquiries grow faster than one person can answer.
More late nights don't fix that. A better process does.
Start small: track one week of enquiries and save a quick first reply on WhatsApp.
